title: ioctl error while running gemeni cli

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a clear, actionable bug report detailing a runtime error ('ioctl(2) failed, EBADF') when gemini-cli resizes a pseudo-terminal (node-pty) while executing shell commands on Linux (Raspberry Pi 5). It includes full stack traces, terminal details, environment info, and expected behavior.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue involves node-pty native pseudo-terminal handling and ioctl system call failures on Linux. According to the effort estimation guidelines, any bug involving node-pty, pseudo-terminal signal handling, or low-level platform-specific IPC is categorized as LARGE effort due to the testing complexity across native environments.

summary.problem: Terminal resize operations during shell command execution cause an uncaught 'ioctl(2) failed, EBADF' exception in node-pty, resulting in CLI crashes.
summary.root_cause: In UnixTerminal.resize in node-pty, calling pty.resize when the file descriptor is already bad or closed throws an Error with message 'ioctl(2) failed, EBADF'. While ShellExecutionService.resizePty attempts to catch EBADF/ESRCH errors, it needs to reliably match the 'ioctl(2) failed, EBADF' error message string to ignore race conditions when the process exits during resize.
summary.context: UI layout updates trigger ShellExecutionService.resizePty. On Unix systems, if a shell command exits concurrently with a terminal resize event, the underlying PTY file descriptor becomes invalid (EBADF), throwing an exception.

steps: In packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.ts, locate the resizePty method catch block.
Update the error check in the catch block to inspect if err.message or String(e) includes 'ioctl(2) failed' or 'EBADF' or 'ioctl'.
Ensure that any ioctl EBADF errors thrown by node-pty during terminal resizes are caught and ignored safely without rethrowing.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: ShellExecutionService.resizePty swallows 'ioctl(2) failed, EBADF' errors thrown by node-pty and completes execution without throwing.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts testing that ShellExecutionService.resizePty ignores 'ioctl(2) failed, EBADF' errors.
Mock activePty.ptyProcess.resize to throw new Error('ioctl(2) failed, EBADF').
Assert that calling ShellExecutionService.resizePty does not throw an error.
